title: Find the right graph for any branch
summary: Use one lookup to resolve a branch to its graph kind, tracked scope, current source SHA, and freshest available receipt.
benefits: A developer can start from a branch or feature name and reach the applicable evidence quickly.
risks: Shared file sets must not be mistaken for equivalent branch behavior.

evidence.claim: AlderVale's main and feature snapshots are published under different paths and pin different source commits.
